positions.name: AsyncRememberContractCommitments
positions.frame: what guarantees does the ratified async remember contract commit to, and how does the agent observe completion?
positions.why: All three expressions read as one settled decision spoken from inside it: src-1 names the contract and its receipt/polling mechanism as ratified, src-2 states the negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work) that make the contract trustworthy, and src-3 specifies the two observation paths (poll or piggyback) the agent has post-dispatch. The conviction pass marks all three as decision-register rather than argued positions, and register marks all three as native pipeline vocabulary — the group coheres as a single directional read of a design already settled, not three separate claims being weighed.
